You are rolling out a new hero header across customer-portal pages in a Next.js 15 App Router app. Work ONLY in the git worktree at /opt/nxeon-wt-mktg (NOT /opt/nxeon).

A reusable component now exists: `components/portal/PortalHero.tsx`. Read it first. It is a drop-in upgrade of `PageHeader` from `components/ui/primitives.tsx`: SAME props `title` (ReactNode), `sub?` (string), and `children` (right-side action buttons), PLUS a `variant` (string) that selects a page-specific illustration + accent. Signature: `<PortalHero variant="servers" title={…} sub="…">{actions}</PortalHero>`.

YOUR TASK: In each page file listed below, replace its `<PageHeader …>…</PageHeader>` usage with `<PortalHero variant="…" …>…</PortalHero>`, preserving the exact `title`, `sub`, and any children/action buttons verbatim. Then fix imports: add `import { PortalHero } from "@/components/portal/PortalHero";` and, if `PageHeader` is no longer used in that file, remove ONLY `PageHeader` from its `@/components/ui/primitives` import (KEEP other named imports like `EmptyState`, `Badge`, `StatCard`, etc.).

PAGES + variant to use (only edit these; each is under app/dashboard/):
- servers/page.tsx → variant="servers"
- hosting/page.tsx → variant="hosting"
- games/page.tsx → variant="games"
- nxcloud/page.tsx → variant="nxcloud"
- volumes/page.tsx → variant="volumes"
- migrate/page.tsx → variant="migrate"
- migrate/consolidate/page.tsx → variant="migrate"
- domains/page.tsx → variant="domains"
- domains/register/page.tsx → variant="domains"
- domains/transfer/page.tsx → variant="domains"
- domains/ideas/page.tsx → variant="domains"
- ssl/page.tsx → variant="ssl"
- claude-code/page.tsx → variant="build"
- build/page.tsx → variant="matrix"
- mail/page.tsx → variant="mail"
- email/page.tsx → variant="email"
- sites/page.tsx → variant="sites"
- calendar/page.tsx → variant="calendar"

RULES:
- Only swap where the page renders `<PageHeader …>`. If a page in the list does NOT use PageHeader (renders a bespoke custom header, or uses `page-title` directly), LEAVE IT UNCHANGED and note it in your report — do NOT force a hero in.
- Preserve title/sub/actions EXACTLY. Do not reword copy. If `title` is a ReactNode (e.g. includes a status badge), keep it as-is.
- Do NOT edit any detail pages ([id]) or any file not in the list.
- Do NOT edit `components/portal/PortalHero.tsx`, `components/ui/primitives.tsx`, or `app/dashboard/layout.tsx`.
- Do NOT run git, npm/build, or prisma. Edit files only.
- Keep each file otherwise identical (server/client directive, other imports, logic untouched).

REPORT BACK (concise): a list of which files you edited (with the variant used), which listed files you SKIPPED and why (no PageHeader / bespoke header), and confirm PageHeader imports were cleaned up where it became unused.

This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats.
